The card shows only R21 (which is rash) for C0261702 and J06.9 for C0261993. The rash label is inferred from the code and not stated on the card. C0261993 does fit URI.","The summary says the 99215 share runs 'roughly double the all-provider share in every band'. In the 0-condition band the ratio is 0.032/0.022 = 1.45, and in the 5+ band it is 0.471/0.202 = 2.3. 'Roughly double' is loose for the low band.","C0261405, C0261661 and C0261710 are cited as problems-flagged notes. C0261405 is a 99214 on the card. C0261661 and C0261710 appear nowhere on the card, and no tool output shows note flags per claim. These look ungrounded.","The 'repeated-time rate' is mentioned as a signal, but no figure for it is given in the summary or on the card, so it is unsupported.","The summary says documented 99215s are 'supported at a rate better than peers'. The basis is 1 of 17 below billed (6%) against 9%, which is a very small sample, and the difference is not meaningful. The summary does acknowledge the sample is thin.","The example claims cited are the one below-billed claim and two low-complexity 99215 claims. No supported-documentation example is cited, so the evidence for the 'supportive' side is not shown.","The claim that 'cloning cannot be ruled out' and that templating could make notes look supportive is speculative.
